summary.ja: この期間は概ね平常通りで、Korea Zincに有利な裁判所の判断、Semi5の過去最高の受注残高、新たな資本市場改革計画が、KOSDAQの低迷とKOSPIの1カ月12%下落への批判を相殺した。海外報道はまちまちで、Nvidia関連の市場下落とJensen Huang氏をめぐるスキャンダルがあったが、全体の論調は世界平均より穏やかである。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평이했다. Korea Zinc에 유리한 법원 판결, Semi5의 사상 최대 수주잔고, 새로운 자본시장 개혁 계획이 KOSDAQ 부진과 KOSPI 한 달간 12% 하락에 대한 비판을 상쇄했다. 해외 보도는 엇갈렸으며, 엔비디아 관련 시장 하락과 젠슨 황을 둘러싼 스캔들이 있었지만 전반적인 어조는 세계 평균보다 온건하다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य रही, जिसमें Korea Zinc के पक्ष में अदालती फैसला, Semi5 का रिकॉर्ड ऑर्डर बैकलॉग और नई पूंजी बाज़ार सुधार योजनाएँ KOSDAQ की सुस्ती और एक महीने में KOSPI में 12% गिरावट की आलोचना को संतुलित करती रहीं। विदेशी कवरेज मिली-जुली रही, जिसमें Nvidia से जुड़ी बाज़ार गिरावट और Jensen Huang से जुड़ा घोटाला शामिल है, लेकिन समग्र स्वर विश्व औसत से नरम है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη, με δικαστική απόφαση υπέρ της Korea Zinc, ρεκόρ παραγγελιών στην Semi5 και νέα σχέδια μεταρρύθμισης της κεφαλαιαγοράς που αντισταθμίζουν την κριτική για την πτώση του KOSDAQ και την πτώση του KOSPI κατά 12% σε ένα μήνα. Η ξένη κάλυψη είναι μικτή, με πτώση της αγοράς συνδεδεμένη με τη Nvidia και σκάνδαλο γύρω από τον Jensen Huang, αλλά συνολικά ο τόνος είναι πιο ήπιος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyrediyor; Korea Zinc lehine bir mahkeme kararı, Semi5'te rekor sipariş birikimi ve yeni sermaye piyasası reform planları, KOSDAQ'taki düşüşe ve KOSPI'deki bir aylık %12'lik gerilemeye yönelik eleştirileri dengeliyor. Yurt dışı haberler karışık; Nvidia ile bağlantılı bir piyasa düşüşü ve Jensen Huang etrafındaki bir skandal öne çıkıyor, ancak genel ton dünya ortalamasına göre daha ılımlı.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: un fallo judicial a favor de Korea Zinc, un récord en la cartera de pedidos de Semi5 y nuevos planes de reforma del mercado de capitales compensan las críticas por la caída del KOSDAQ y el descenso del 12% del KOSPI en un mes. La cobertura extranjera es mixta, con una caída del mercado relacionada con Nvidia y un escándalo en torno a Jensen Huang, pero el tono general es más moderado que la media mundial.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : une décision de justice favorable à Korea Zinc, un carnet de commandes record chez Semi5 et de nouveaux projets de réforme du marché des capitaux compensent les critiques liées au repli du KOSDAQ et à la baisse de 12 % du KOSPI sur un mois. La couverture étrangère est contrastée, avec une baisse du marché liée à Nvidia et un scandale autour de Jensen Huang, mais le ton général reste plus modéré que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Ein Gerichtsurteil zugunsten von Korea Zinc, ein Rekord-Auftragsbestand bei Semi5 und neue Pläne zur Reform des Kapitalmarkts gleichen die Kritik am Einbruch des KOSDAQ und den Rückgang des KOSPI um 12 % im Monatsverlauf aus. Die ausländische Berichterstattung ist gemischt, mit einem Marktrückgang im Zusammenhang mit Nvidia und einem Skandal um Jensen Huang, insgesamt ist der Ton jedoch milder als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte rotineiro: uma decisão judicial favorável à Korea Zinc, uma carteira de encomendas recorde na Semi5 e novos planos de reforma do mercado de capitais compensam as críticas à queda do KOSDAQ e à baixa de 12% do KOSPI no mês. A cobertura estrangeira é mista, com uma queda de mercado ligada à Nvidia e um escândalo envolvendo Jensen Huang, mas o tom geral é mais ameno do que a média mundial.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine, con una sentenza del tribunale favorevole a Korea Zinc, un record di ordini arretrati per Semi5 e nuovi piani di riforma del mercato dei capitali che controbilanciano le critiche al crollo del KOSDAQ e al calo del 12% del KOSPI in un mese. La copertura estera è mista, con un calo del mercato legato a Nvidia e uno scandalo che coinvolge Jensen Huang, ma il tono complessivo è più moderato della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: решение суда в пользу Korea Zinc, рекордный портфель заказов у Semi5 и новые планы реформы рынка капитала уравновешивают критику из-за спада KOSDAQ и падения KOSPI на 12% за месяц. Зарубежные публикации неоднозначны: снижение рынка, связанное с Nvidia, и скандал вокруг Дженсена Хуанга, однако общий тон мягче, чем в среднем по миру.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها، مع حكم قضائي لصالح Korea Zinc، وتراكم طلبات قياسي لدى Semi5، وخطط جديدة لإصلاح سوق رأس المال تعادل الانتقادات المتعلقة بتراجع KOSDAQ وانخفاض KOSPI بنسبة 12% خلال شهر. التغطية الخارجية متباينة، مع هبوط في السوق مرتبط بشركة Nvidia وفضيحة تتعلق بجنسن هوانغ، لكن النبرة العامة أخف من متوسط العالم.
summary.fa: این دوره بیشتر عادی است؛ با حکم دادگاه به نفع Korea Zinc، رکورد سفارش‌های معوق در Semi5 و برنامه‌های جدید اصلاح بازار سرمایه که انتقادها به افت KOSDAQ و کاهش ۱۲ درصدی KOSPI در یک ماه را خنثی می‌کند. پوشش خارجی متفاوت است، با افت بازار مرتبط با Nvidia و رسوایی پیرامون Jensen Huang، اما لحن کلی ملایم‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.

Главным негативным фактором стало задержание руководителей «Самрук-Казына» и «Национальных железных дорог» в рамках расследования по делу о коррупции; это заметное, но институциональное событие, а не кризис.
summary.ar: تسير الفترة في معظمها وفق المعتاد، مع تطورات إيجابية في الاقتصاد والبنية التحتية (تعزيز التنغي، رحلات جوية جديدة، قانون للعلوم، ومستشفيات ومركز بيانات مخططة). والعامل السلبي الرئيسي هو احتجاز رئيسي شركة «سامروك-كازينا» و«السكك الحديدية الوطنية» في إطار تحقيق في قضايا فساد، وهو تطور لافت لكنه مؤسسي وليس أزمة.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است و شامل مواردی مثبت در حوزه اقتصاد و زیرساخت است (تقویت تنگه، پروازهای جدید، قانون علم، و بیمارستان‌ها و مرکز داده برنامه‌ریزی‌شده). مهم‌ترین مورد منفی بازداشت رؤسای «سامروک-قازینا» و «راه‌آهن ملی» در پرونده فساد است؛ این تحول قابل توجه است اما نهادی است و بحران محسوب نمی‌شود.
summary.zh: 该时期总体属于常规情况，经济和基础设施方面有若干积极进展（坚戈走强、新增航班、通过科学法、计划建设医院和数据中心）。主要负面事件是萨姆鲁克-卡兹纳和国家铁路公司负责人因腐败调查被拘留；这是一项值得关注的体制性进展，但并非危机。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyretti; ekonomi ve altyapıyla ilgili olumlu gelişmeler öne çıktı (tenge değer kazandı, yeni uçuşlar, bir bilim yasası, planlanan hastaneler ve bir veri merkezi). Başlıca olumsuz gelişme, bir yolsuzluk soruşturması kapsamında Samruk-Kazyna ve Ulusal Demiryolları başkanlarının gözaltına alınması oldu; bu dikkate değer bir gelişme olsa da bir kriz değil, kurumsal nitelikte bir gelişmedir.
summary.es: El periodo transcurrió en gran medida con normalidad, con noticias económicas y de infraestructura positivas (fortalecimiento del tenge, nuevos vuelos, una ley de ciencia, hospitales previstos y un centro de datos). El principal aspecto negativo es la detención de los presidentes de Samruk-Kazyna y de los Ferrocarriles Nacionales en una investigación por corrupción, un hecho notable pero de carácter institucional y no una crisis.
summary.fr: La période a été globalement routinière, avec des éléments économiques et d'infrastructure positifs (renforcement du tenge, nouveaux vols, une loi sur la science, hôpitaux prévus et un centre de données). Le principal point négatif est la mise en détention des dirigeants de Samruk-Kazyna et des Chemins de fer nationaux dans le cadre d'une enquête anticorruption, un fait notable mais de nature institutionnelle plutôt qu'une crise.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief überwiegend routinemäßig, mit positiven wirtschaftlichen und infrastrukturellen Meldungen (Erstarken des Tenge, neue Flugverbindungen, ein Wissenschaftsgesetz, geplante Krankenhäuser und ein Rechenzentrum). Die wichtigste negative Entwicklung ist die Festnahme der Leiter von Samruk-Kazyna und der nationalen Eisenbahn im Rahmen eines Korruptionsverfahrens; dies ist eine bemerkenswerte, aber institutionelle Entwicklung und keine Krise.
summary.pt: O período foi, em grande parte, de rotina, com notícias econômicas e de infraestrutura positivas (valorização do tenge, novos voos, uma lei de ciência, hospitais planejados e um data center). O principal ponto negativo é a detenção dos presidentes da Samruk-Kazyna e das Ferrovias Nacionais em uma investigação de corrupção, um fato notável, mas de natureza institucional e não uma crise.
summary.ja: この期間は概ね平常通りで、経済やインフラに関する前向きな動きが見られました（テンゲの上昇、新規航空路線、科学法、計画中の病院とデータセンター）。主なマイナス要因は、汚職捜査でサムルク・カザナとカザフスタン国鉄の責任者が拘束されたことです。これは注目すべき事案ではあるものの、危機ではなく制度上の動きです。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평이했으며, 경제 및 인프라 측면에서 긍정적인 소식이 있었습니다(텡게화 강세, 신규 항공편, 과학법, 계획 중인 병원과 데이터센터). 주요 부정적 사안은 부패 수사 과정에서 사므룩-카즈나와 국영 철도(National Railways)의 수장이 구금된 것입니다. 이는 주목할 만한 사건이지만 위기라기보다는 제도적 차원의 전개입니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि अधिकतर सामान्य रही, जिसमें आर्थिक और बुनियादी ढांचे से जुड़े सकारात्मक घटनाक्रम शामिल हैं (टेंगे में मज़बूती, नई उड़ानें, एक विज्ञान कानून, प्रस्तावित अस्पताल और एक डेटा सेंटर)। मुख्य नकारात्मक घटनाक्रम भ्रष्टाचार जांच में सैमरुक-कज़ीना और नेशनल रेलवेज़ के प्रमुखों की हिरासत है, जो एक उल्लेखनीय लेकिन संस्थागत घटनाक्रम है, संकट नहीं।

Τα αρνητικά περιορίζονται σε προειδοποίηση οίκου αξιολόγησης για κινδύνους δημοσιονομικής προσαρμογής και σε επισήμανση για πιθανή μελλοντική υγειονομική κρίση, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

Olumsuz haberler, mali ayarlama riskleri konusunda bir derecelendirme kuruluşunun uyarısı ve gelecekte olası bir sağlık krizine ilişkin bir uyarıyla sınırlı; bu nedenle puan sıradan bir günün biraz üzerinde.

summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: incontri sportivi, approfondimenti economici e premi culturali, con alcune notizie aziendali positive, come i ricavi record di Conaprole. summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: مشاريع البنية التحتية، وتخصيصات الميزانية، ونمو السياحة والتحويلات المالية، واكتشاف مصدر للغاز. وفي المقابل، حذّر الرئيس من استفزازات عرقية مخطط لها في الجنوب قبل الانتخابات، وأُقيل سفير في خضم فضيحة تتعلق بالأراضي، وتتسم نغمة GDELT بسلبية أكبر من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: پروژه‌های زیرساختی، تخصیص بودجه، رشد گردشگری و حواله‌ها، و کشف یک منبع گاز. در مقابل، رئیس‌جمهور از تحریکات قومی برنامه‌ریزی‌شده در جنوب پیش از انتخابات هشدار داد و یک سفیر در پی یک رسوایی زمین برکنار شد؛ لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 这一时期总体属于常规情况：基础设施项目、预算拨款、旅游业和汇款增长以及一项天然气发现。与之相抵的是，总统警告称选举前南部可能出现有预谋的民族挑衅，一名大使因土地丑闻被解职；GDELT的语气比全球平均水平更为负面。
summary.ja: この期間の報道はおおむね定例的なものです。インフラ事業、予算配分、観光と送金の増加、ガス田の発見が含まれます。一方で、大統領が選挙を前に南部での民族間挑発を計画していると警告し、土地スキャンダルをめぐって大使が解任されました。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりも否定的です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간 보도는 대체로 일상적인 내용입니다. 인프라 사업, 예산 배정, 관광 및 송금 증가, 가스 발견 소식이 포함되어 있습니다. 반면 대통령은 선거를 앞두고 남부에서 민족 간 도발이 계획되고 있다고 경고했고, 토지 스캔들과 관련해 대사가 해임되었습니다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 부정적입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि की खबरें ज़्यादातर नियमित हैं: बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाएं, बजट आवंटन, पर्यटन और प्रेषण (रेमिटेंस) में वृद्धि, तथा एक गैस खोज। इसके विपरीत, राष्ट्रपति ने चुनावों से पहले दक्षिण में नस्लीय/जातीय उकसावे की योजना की चेतावनी दी, और भूमि घोटाले के बीच एक राजदूत को हटाया गया। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική: έργα υποδομών, κατανομές προϋπολογισμού, αύξηση του τουρισμού και των εμβασμάτων, καθώς και μια ανακάλυψη φυσικού αερίου. Αντίβαρο σε αυτά, ο πρόεδρος προειδοποίησε για σχεδιαζόμενες εθνοτικές προκλήσεις στον νότο ενόψει εκλογών, και ένας πρέσβης απομακρύνθηκε εν μέσω σκανδάλου γης. Ο τόνος στο GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.

summary.en: The agenda in China consists of export controls on artificial intelligence technologies, messages from the Lujiazui Forum and market stability, and ongoing tensions with the United States and India. Growth is recovering, but weak consumer spending, unemployment concerns and a 4.5% monthly decline in the Shanghai index weigh negatively; there is no clear crisis or major positive development. The period is therefore considered ordinary.

en: Tightening of export controls on artificial intelligence technologies and technology competition with the United States
Growth is accelerating, but consumers prefer saving to spending
A 4.5% decline in the stock market over the last month, and policy signals supporting the market (PBOC, chairman of the SEC/CSRC)
Tension over a US warship in the South China Sea and a debate with India over the Ladakh/Aksai Chin rhetoric
Reports of the closure of schools in Tibet and of hidden unemployment

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: trade fairs, financial-forum policy commentary, and stability signals from institutions, with GDELT tone above the world average. Offsetting this were US sanctions and blacklisting of Chinese firms, South China Sea and Taiwan tensions, and a 6% one-month decline in the SSE Composite.

Canton Fair and China Import and Export Fair showcasing trade and innovation
US sanctions and blacklisting of Chinese firms; Taiwan-related tensions

summary.en: The day's coverage is mostly routine: APEC hosting preparations, local policy plans and everyday business and culture stories. Negatives include a soft consumer event, a property project stall and unannounced military drills near Taiwan, while the SSE index is slightly down over the month and GDELT tone is milder than the world average.
summary.tr: Günün haberleri çoğunlukla rutin nitelikte: APEC'in ev sahipliğine yönelik hazırlıklar, yerel politika planları ve günlük iş ve kültür haberleri. Olumsuz unsurlar arasında zayıf bir tüketici etkinliği, bir emlak projesinin durması ve Tayvan yakınlarında önceden duyurulmamış askeri tatbikatlar yer alıyor; SSE endeksi ay boyunca hafifçe gerilerken GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasına göre daha ılımlı.
summary.es: La cobertura del día es en su mayoría rutinaria: preparativos para que China acoja el APEC, planes de política local e historias cotidianas de negocios y cultura. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran un evento de consumo débil, el estancamiento de un proyecto inmobiliario y maniobras militares no anunciadas cerca de Taiwán, mientras que el índice SSE cae ligeramente en el mes y el tono de GDELT es más moderado que la media mundial.
summary.fr: La couverture de la journée est pour l'essentiel routinière : préparatifs de l'accueil de l'APEC, plans de politique locale et reportages quotidiens sur les affaires et la culture. Les éléments négatifs incluent un événement de consommation peu dynamique, le blocage d'un projet immobilier et des exercices militaires non annoncés près de Taïwan, tandis que l'indice SSE recule légèrement sur le mois et que le ton de GDELT est plus modéré que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung des Tages ist überwiegend routinemäßig: Vorbereitungen für die Ausrichtung des APEC-Gipfels, lokale politische Pläne sowie alltägliche Wirtschafts- und Kulturthemen. Negative Meldungen betreffen eine schwache Verbraucherveranstaltung, einen stockenden Immobilienprojekt und unangekündigte Militärübungen nahe Taiwan, während der SSE-Index im Monatsverlauf leicht nachgibt und der GDELT-Ton milder ausfällt als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: A cobertura do dia é majoritariamente rotineira: preparativos para a sediação da APEC, planos de políticas locais e notícias cotidianas de negócios e cultura. Entre os aspectos negativos estão um evento de consumo fraco, um projeto imobiliário paralisado e exercícios militares não anunciados perto de Taiwan, enquanto o índice SSE recua levemente no mês e o tom do GDELT é mais brando que a média mundial.
summary.ja: 本日の報道は大半が日常的な内容です。APEC開催に向けた準備、地方政策の計画、ビジネスや文化に関する話題などが中心です。マイナス材料としては、消費関連イベントの低迷、不動産プロジェクトの停滞、台湾周辺での予告のない軍事演習が挙がっています。一方、SSE指数は月間でわずかに下落しており、GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりも穏やかです。
summary.ko: 오늘의 보도는 대체로 일상적인 내용입니다. APEC 개최 준비, 지방 정책 계획, 기업 및 문화 관련 소식이 주를 이룹니다. 부정적 요인으로는 부진한 소비 행사, 부동산 프로젝트의 정체, 대만 인근의 사전 통보 없는 군사 훈련이 언급되었습니다. 한편 SSE 지수는 한 달 기준으로 소폭 하락했으며, GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 온건합니다.
summary.hi: आज की कवरेज ज़्यादातर नियमित प्रकृति की है: APEC की मेज़बानी की तैयारियाँ, स्थानीय नीति योजनाएँ और रोज़मर्रा के व्यापार व संस्कृति से जुड़ी खबरें। नकारात्मक पहलुओं में एक कमज़ोर उपभोक्ता कार्यक्रम, एक संपत्ति परियोजना में ठहराव और ताइवान के पास बिना पूर्व घोषणा के सैन्य अभ्यास शामिल हैं, जबकि SSE सूचकांक महीने भर में थोड़ा नीचे है और GDELT स्वर विश्व औसत से नरम है।
summary.el: Η σημερινή κάλυψη είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη: προετοιμασίες για τη φιλοξενία της APEC, τοπικά σχέδια πολιτικής και ειδήσεις για την καθημερινή οικονομία και τον πολιτισμό. Τα αρνητικά στοιχεία περιλαμβάνουν μια αδύναμη εκδήλωση για τους καταναλωτές, ένα πάγωμα σε έργο ακινήτων και στρατιωτικές ασκήσεις χωρίς προειδοποίηση κοντά στην Ταϊβάν, ενώ ο δείκτης SSE υποχώρησε ελαφρά μέσα στον μήνα και ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ηπιότερος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.it: La copertura del giorno è per lo più di routine: preparativi per l'ospitare l'APEC, piani di politica locale e notizie quotidiane su economia e cultura. Tra gli aspetti negativi figurano un debole evento per i consumatori, lo stallo di un progetto immobiliare ed esercitazioni militari non annunciate vicino a Taiwan, mentre l'indice SSE è leggermente in calo nel corso del mese e il tono di GDELT è più moderato della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Новости дня в основном рутинные: подготовка к проведению АТЭС, местные планы в сфере политики и повседневные бизнес- и культурные сюжеты. К негативным моментам относятся слабое потребительское мероприятие, застой проекта в сфере недвижимости и неанонсированные военные учения у Тайваня, тогда как индекс SSE за месяц немного снизился, а тональность GDELT мягче среднемировой.
summary.ar: التغطية الإخبارية لهذا اليوم روتينية في معظمها: تحضيرات استضافة منتدى التعاون الاقتصادي لآسيا والمحيط الهادئ (APEC)، وخطط سياسات محلية، وقصص يومية عن الأعمال والثقافة. ومن الجوانب السلبية حدث استهلاكي ضعيف، وتعثر مشروع عقاري، ومناورات عسكرية غير معلنة قرب تايوان، بينما انخفض مؤشر SSE قليلاً خلال الشهر، وكانت نبرة GDELT أكثر اعتدالاً من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: پوشش خبری امروز عمدتاً روتین است: آماده‌سازی برای میزبانی از اجلاس APEC، برنامه‌های سیاست محلی و اخبار روزمره تجاری و فرهنگی. موارد منفی شامل یک رویداد ضعیف مصرف‌کنندگان، توقف یک پروژه ملکی و مانورهای نظامی اعلام‌نشده نزدیک تایوان است، در حالی که شاخص SSE در طول ماه اندکی کاهش یافته و لحن GDELT ملایم‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 当日报道大多属于常规内容：筹办亚太经合组织（APEC）会议、地方政策规划以及日常商业和文化新闻。负面内容包括一场消费活动表现疲软、一个房地产项目陷入停滞，以及台湾附近未经宣布的军事演习；与此同时，上证综指本月略有下跌，GDELT语气比全球平均水平温和。

summary.el: Η περίοδος μοιάζει με μια συνηθισμένη μέρα στην Ισλανδία: τακτική κάλυψη πολιτικής και οικονομίας, προειδοποιήσεις καιρού, αποτελέσματα αθλητικών αγώνων και η έναρξη των εργασιών κατασκευής ενός εθνικού αρένας. Οι ήπιες θετικές ειδήσεις (έναρξη κατασκευής, χρηματοδότηση ένταξης μεταναστών) εξισορροπούνται από κριτικά δημοσιεύματα για την κυβερνοασφάλεια, την ευημερία των εργαζομένων και την πολιτική της κεντρικής τράπεζας.
summary.it: Il periodo appare come una giornata ordinaria in Islanda: copertura di routine su politica ed economia, avvisi meteorologici, risultati sportivi e l'avvio dei lavori per un'arena nazionale. Notizie moderatamente positive (l'inizio dei lavori e i fondi per l'integrazione degli immigrati) sono bilanciate da servizi critici su cybersicurezza, benessere dei lavoratori e politica della banca centrale.
summary.ru: Период выглядит как обычный день в Исландии: рутинные материалы о политике и экономике, метеопредупреждения, спортивные результаты и начало строительства национальной арены. Умеренно позитивные новости (начало строительства, финансирование интеграции иммигрантов) уравновешиваются критическими материалами о кибербезопасности, благополучии работников и политике центрального банка.
summary.ar: تبدو الفترة كيوم عادي في آيسلندا: تغطية روتينية للسياسة والاقتصاد، وتحذيرات جوية، ونتائج رياضية، وبداية أعمال البناء في ملعب وطني. وتتوازن الأخبار الإيجابية المعتدلة (بدء البناء وتمويل اندماج المهاجرين) مع تقارير نقدية حول الأمن السيبراني ورفاه العمال وسياسة البنك المركزي.
summary.fa: این دوره مانند یک روز عادی در ایسلند به نظر می‌رسد: پوشش معمول سیاست و اقتصاد، هشدارهای هواشناسی، نتایج ورزشی و آغاز ساخت یک ورزشگاه ملی. اخبار مثبت ملایم (آغاز ساخت و بودجه ادغام مهاجران) با گزارش‌های انتقادی درباره امنیت سایبری، رفاه کارگران و سیاست بانک مرکزی متعادل می‌شود.
summary.zh: 这一时期看起来像冰岛的一个普通日子：政治和经济的常规报道、天气预警、体育赛事结果，以及一座国家体育场的动工。温和的积极消息（动工、移民融入资金）与关于网络安全、工人福利和央行政策的批评性报道相互平衡。

en: Construction began on the new national arena in Laugardalur
Orange weather warnings issued for north and east Iceland
Critical coverage of cybersecurity and worker welfare, with no crisis
tr: Laugardalur'da yeni ulusal spor salonunun inşaatına başlandı
İzlanda'nın kuzey ve doğusu için turuncu hava durumu uyarıları yayımlandı
Kriz olmaksızın siber güvenlik ve çalışan refahına ilişkin eleştirel haberler
es: Comenzaron las obras del nuevo estadio nacional en Laugardalur
Se emitieron avisos meteorológicos naranja para el norte y el este de Islandia
Cobertura crítica sobre ciberseguridad y bienestar laboral, sin crisis
fr: Les travaux de la nouvelle arène nationale ont débuté à Laugardalur
Des alertes météorologiques orange ont été émises pour le nord et l'est de l'Islande
Couverture critique de la cybersécurité et du bien-être des salariés, sans crise
de: In Laugardalur begann der Bau der neuen nationalen Arena
Für Nord- und Ostisland wurden orangefarbene Wetterwarnungen herausgegeben
Kritische Berichterstattung zu Cybersicherheit und Arbeitnehmerwohl, ohne Krise
pt: Iniciou-se a construção da nova arena nacional em Laugardalur
Foram emitidos alertas meteorológicos laranja para o norte e leste da Islândia
Cobertura crítica sobre cibersegurança e bem-estar dos trabalhadores, sem crise
ja: ラウガルダルルムルに新しい国立競技場の建設が始まった
アイスランド北部および東部に オレンジ色の気象警報が発令された
サイバーセキュリティと労働者の福祉に関する批判的な報道があるが、危機とまではいえない
ko: 라우가달루르에 새 국립 경기장 건설이 시작되었습니다
아이슬란드 북부와 동부 지역에 주황색 기상 경보가 발령되었습니다
사이버 보안과 근로자 복지에 관한 비판적 보도가 있었으나 위기 상황은 아닙니다
hi: लौगारडालुर में नए राष्ट्रीय एरिना का निर्माण शुरू हुआ
उत्तरी और पूर्वी आइसलैंड के लिए नारंगी मौसम चेतावनियाँ जारी की गईं
साइबर सुरक्षा और कर्मचारी कल्याण पर आलोचनात्मक कवरेज, किसी संकट के बिना
el: Ξεκίνησε η κατασκευή του νέου εθνικού αρένας στο Laugardalur
Εκδόθηκαν πορτοκαλί προειδοποιήσεις καιρού για το βορρά και την ανατολή της Ισλανδίας
Κριτική κάλυψη για την κυβερνοασφάλεια και την ευημερία των εργαζομένων, χωρίς κρίση
it: Sono iniziati i lavori per la nuova arena nazionale a Laugardalur
Emessi avvisi meteorologici arancioni per il nord e l'est dell'Islanda
Copertura critica su cybersicurezza e benessere dei lavoratori, senza crisi
ru: Началось строительство новой национальной арены в Laugardalur
Выпущены оранжевые метеопредупреждения для севера и востока Исландии
Критическое освещение кибербезопасности и благополучия работников, без кризиса
ar: بدأ البناء في الملعب الوطني الجديد في Laugardalur
صدرت تحذيرات طقس برتقالية لشمال آيسلندا وشرقها
تغطية نقدية للأمن السيبراني ورفاه العمال، دون أزمة
fa: ساخت ورزشگاه ملی جدید در Laugardalur آغاز شد
هشدارهای هواشناسی نارنجی برای شمال و شرق ایسلند صادر شد
پوشش انتقادی امنیت سایبری و رفاه کارگران، بدون بحران
zh: 位于Laugardalur的新国家体育场已开工建设
冰岛北部和东部发布橙色天气预警
对网络安全和工人福利的批评性报道，但未出现危机

summary.en: A landslide and collapse at an illegal gold mine killed 14 people and injured 7. Separately, a Black Hawk helicopter crashed in Cauca, the investigation into the assassination of Miguel Uribe is in the news, debate over militarizing Bogotá is ongoing, and the stock market fell 2.15% in a day. In contrast, Bogotá, Cali and Medellín ranked among the top 10 in Latin America for economic performance, received tourism awards, and economy and infrastructure news was calm, so the score did not drop much.

en: Collapse at an illegal gold mine with 14 deaths
Military helicopter crash in Cauca
Daily stock market decline of 2.15%
Investigation into the assassination of Miguel Uribe and debate over militarization in Bogotá
Positive news on the economic performance and tourism awards of major cities

summary.en: The period mixes security tension (an alleged ELN attempt on the president, a planned offensive against armed groups, prison transfers) with a deadly illegal mine landslide that killed 14 and protests over museum removals. Positives include a signed US-Colombia critical minerals and nuclear cooperation arrangement, while the stock index was roughly flat and the news tone was more negative than the global average.

en: Alleged ELN assassination attempt against President De la Espriella
Illegal gold mine landslide kills 14 people
US-Colombia critical minerals and civil nuclear arrangements signed

summary.en: The period is dominated by a cabinet shake-up after the Presidency's budget setback, plus protests over the removal of museum artworks and warnings about gas prices and a blackout bill. Offsetting this are a record cocaine seizure, a routine IMF mission and port throughput above target, so the day sits slightly below an ordinary period.

en: Interior minister Rodrigo Lara removed after budget setback
Protests over removal of art exhibits deemed communist
Record 7.6-tonne cocaine seizure at Cartagena port

summary.en: The day mixed a positive corporate rescue (700 jobs saved at Presto) and IDB financing with a cabinet resignation, a deadly military strike on an ELN camp, a journalist's murder by dissidents, and a 0.74% stock decline. Overall this is a somewhat tense but otherwise routine day, slightly below an ordinary one.

en: Interior Minister Rodrigo Lara resigned after two months in office
Air strike killed nine ELN members in Cauca
Journalist Mateo Pérez Rueda's murder by dissidents, forensic details released

summary.en: The period is mixed: the central bank raised rates to 12.25% and the government postponed over 10 trillion pesos in debt payments, while security and institutional items (an extradition, an anti-ELN seizure, stable homicide levels) were routine or mildly positive. The COLCAP index is down 2.9% over the month, and the news tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Central bank raises policy rate to 12.25%, signalling inflation pressure
Government postpones over 10 trillion pesos in debt payments
Extradition and anti-ELN seizure show routine security enforcement

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine: post-election politics, a fiscal adjustment outlook, and regional flooding, alongside a police officer's killing in Cali and an arrest of FARC dissidents. The stock index is flat to slightly down over the month and the news tone is slightly more negative than the world average, so the score sits just below neutral.

en: Killing of a police officer in Cali and government response
Capture of four FARC dissident members
Flooding and traffic chaos in the Caribbean region

summary.en: The period mixes security gains, with several outlets reporting the killing of ELN commanders and fighters, against fiscal and climate strain: a delayed $3.3 billion debt payment, $855 million pledged to avert blackouts, El Niño saving campaigns, and Caribbean flood alerts. Cabinet churn and a fiscal-rescue law announcement add political uncertainty, and the stock index is down over the month.

en: Delayed US$3.3B debt payment and US$855M blackout-prevention pledge
Caribbean floods and Santa Marta red alert
Military operation killing ELN commanders and about ten fighters

summary.en: The period is dominated by the assassination of a mayoral pre-candidate in Cúcuta, a deadly attack killing at least six in southwestern Colombia, and a hospital killing in Cauca, all signalling widespread violence. The stock index fell about 2% and news tone is more negative than the world average, partly offset by the return of a global bond sale and the government's pledge to pursue the killers.

en: Assassination of mayoral pre-candidate Miguel Castellanos in Cúcuta
At least six killed in attack in southwestern Colombia
Armed killing of patient at Suárez, Cauca hospital

summary.en: The period is dominated by armed-group violence: a bombing near the Venezuelan border injured at least four police, a drone attack by FARC dissidents killed a marine, and six people died in an attack in the southwest. Political and institutional tensions also rose, with a court-ordered asset freeze on the Pacto Histórico and disputes over the presidency rules. Markets were mixed, with a small daily gain but weaker weekly and monthly performance.

en: Deadly FARC dissident drone attack kills a marine
At least six killed in southwestern Colombia attack
Bomb blast near Venezuelan border injures police

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: court-ordered restitution of museum works, RTVC media governance changes, and health investment announcements. Offsetting this are a sixth military bombing campaign against armed groups with reported child deaths, a 0.5% peso slip, and a weak month for the COLCAP index.

en: Sixth bombing against armed groups; six dead, eight minors reported
Military control operations in Sumapaz and Usme ordered
Weak COLCAP month (-3.34%) and peso slip

summary.en: The period is dominated by security escalation: troops ordered into Cúcuta after a violence wave, drone strikes displacing about 1,447 people in El Tarra, and foreign reports of US troop deployment. Fiscal and economic stress adds to the strain, with a contested US$13B 'Rescue Law' facing Congress and the COLCAP index slipping. Routine news (sports, lifestyle, local incidents) fills much of the flow.

en: Militarization of Cúcuta ordered after a violence wave
Drone strikes displace 1,447 people in El Tarra
Rescue Law with new taxes faces congressional opposition

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and infrastructure news, including falling unemployment, rising factory confidence, new jobs and the UN mission's renewal, with negatives such as a 1.83% peso drop, violence in Ataco and cuts threatening a human rights court. On balance it reads as a routine day, slightly positive.

en: Unemployment falls to 8%, factory confidence climbs
Peso falls 1.83% and stock index declines
Violence and disputes by armed dissidents in Ataco, Tolima

summary.en: The period is mostly routine governance news: a contested fiscal adjustment and rescue law, and the closing of the pension reform debate. Offsetting this, a reported Venezuelan strike on an ELN guerrilla camp left several dead, and the COLCAP index fell over the week and month, so the score sits slightly below a typical day.

en: Contested fiscal adjustment and rescue law with IVA changes pending
Pension reform definitively settled, giving institutional clarity
Reported Venezuelan strike on ELN leaves several dead

summary.en: The period is dominated by armed attacks, including a drone and explosives bombing in Planadas, Tolima that killed four people, among them a two-month-old baby, plus a police officer killed in Huila. Economic signals are also weak: the COLCAP fell over the month, Cúcuta lost 11,000 jobs, a union called a national strike, and the government warned of default if a bill fails.

en: Planadas, Tolima drone-bomb attack kills four, including an infant
Police officer killed in Huila attack; Algeciras bombing kills officer
Union national strike call and default warning over a pending bill

summary.en: The period was dominated by a cluster of bombings and drone attacks that killed soldiers and civilians, including a baby, across several regions, alongside a UN decision narrowing the verification mission and a weaker stock market. Some positive signals, such as an arrest of a suspect abroad and ongoing legislative work, do not offset the widespread violence.

en: Truck bomb and attacks killed four civilians, including a baby
Drone attack killed two soldiers in Chocó
UN narrowed verification mission and dropped rural reform oversight

summary.en: The period mixes a legislative win, the approval of the submission law for armed groups, with serious security incidents, including drone and car-bomb attacks and a military base attack that killed four. Fiscal strain (a possible IMF loan, a proposed gasoline tax, a fuel shortage) and a weaker peso add to the pressure, so the score sits in the serious-problems range but not at crisis level.

en: Submission law approved by Congress and sent for presidential sanction
Drone and military base attacks leave several dead
Possible IMF loan and proposed 19% gasoline sales tax

summary.en: Mixed day: export growth, a Japan trade deal, an oil-restart plan and a Senate-approved vape tax sit alongside a called national strike against government reforms, military operations, an ELN kidnapping and criticism of the health-system plan. GDELT tone is quite negative, but no major crackdown or disaster appears in the headlines, so the score stays close to an ordinary day.

en: Nationwide strike called by unions against De la Espriella's reforms
Security operations, bombings and militarized cities criticized in first 90 days
Export growth of 16.4% and Japan trade deal planned

summary.en: Colombia's period is mixed but leans negative: security is tense, with reported bombings, militarized cities, a rebel seizure of an officer and a national strike called for November 19. Economic signals are soft (stock index down 0.88% on the day and 4.82% over the month), though the peso gained and some business and cultural news was positive.

en: Bombings and militarized cities mark the first 90 days of security policy
Rebels seize officer María Pantoja
National strike announced for November 19

summary.en: Coverage is mostly routine politics and business, with a new government pushing tax and fiscal reforms and the Petro probe continuing. Markets are slightly down, and one foreign report of a magnitude 7.4 earthquake is unconfirmed by the domestic media, which mention only a minor tremor.

en: Unconfirmed foreign report of a magnitude 7.4 earthquake
Fiscal reform push and Goldman warning on fiscal plan
Largest arms seizure in decades and rebel leader killed

summary.en: The period was marked by a drone attack by the ELN that killed three soldiers and wounded 16, plus bomb threats that forced the evacuation of Caracol Televisión's Bogotá headquarters and a security alert for media. Other items were routine or mildly positive, such as eased gas-well rules and continued US aid, and the stock index was roughly flat over the week but down 4% over the month, pointing to a serious security problem rather than a national crisis.

en: ELN drone attack on army base kills three soldiers
Bomb threats force evacuation of Caracol TV headquarters
Security alerts over possible attacks on media in Bogotá

summary.en: The period is dominated by armed-group violence: a drone attack that killed three soldiers in Bolívar, a toll attack in Cauca, escalating violence in southern Bolívar, and bomb threats forcing media evacuations. Some positives appear, including a reported homicide decline, foreign investment interest and Metro progress, but the security picture and a weaker stock index (-4% over one month) keep the score in the serious-problems range.

en: Drone attack kills three soldiers in Bolívar
Bomb threats force evacuation of Caracol TV; media security reinforced
Escalating armed violence in southern Bolívar, per Defensoría

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic signals, including a 3.45% one-day stock gain, a US$2 billion Ecopetrol bond placement and a US$340 million Netflix investment, with security and governance strains such as a military bombing of FARC dissidents, threats against media and a spy-agency controversy. The negative news tone is heavier than the world average, but the economic news and routine coverage keep the overall picture near an ordinary day.

en: Stock index COLCAP rose 3.45% in one day
Ecopetrol priced US$2.0 billion in international bonds
Netflix announced over US$340 million investment in Colombia

summary.en: Colombia's last 24 hours mix a major earthquake rebuild (estimated US$18B, damaged Cali institutions) and new military strikes against armed dissidents with several surrenders and arrests. Routine politics, a slightly weaker peso and a 1.3% stock drop add mild strain, so the period sits somewhat below an ordinary day.

en: Earthquake rebuild cost estimated at US$18B, with Cali facilities damaged
Airstrikes against FARC dissidents, plus dissident leaders surrendering
Peso slipped to 3,297 per dollar; COLCAP fell 1.31% in one day

summary.en: The period combined earthquake recovery strains, a police officer killed in an armed attack, a kidnapping, threats against media, and a call for a national strike against a tax reform. Institutional checks held, with the Constitutional Court upholding the quake emergency, but the stock index fell and fiscal concerns were raised, so the day leans toward serious problems.

en: Earthquake fund controversy and disputed quake emergency management
Police officer killed in Casanare; kidnapping of mayor's wife
Threats against media and a national strike call over tax reform

summary.en: The period mixes serious security problems, including attacks on police, a grenade blast outside a TV network, an air strike, and a kidnapping, with an ongoing debate over a claimed rise in armed-group attacks. Economic signals are mixed: the stock index fell about 1% on the day and 4.7% over the month, while Ecopetrol and Mineros reported strong profits, and most other coverage is routine.
summary.it: Il periodo combina gravi problemi di sicurezza, tra cui attacchi contro la polizia, un'esplosione di granata davanti a un'emittente televisiva, un raid aereo e un sequestro, con un dibattito in corso sull'asserito aumento degli attacchi di gruppi armati. I segnali economici sono contrastanti: l'indice azionario è sceso di circa l'1% nella giornata e del 4,7% nel mese, mentre Ecopetrol e Mineros hanno riportato profitti solidi, e la maggior parte degli altri articoli è di routine.
summary.ru: Период сочетает серьёзные проблемы безопасности, включая нападения на полицию, взрыв гранаты у телеканала, авиаудар и похищение, а также продолжающуюся дискуссию о заявленном росте нападений вооружённых группировок. Экономические сигналы неоднозначны: фондовый индекс упал примерно на 1% за день и на 4,7% за месяц, тогда как Ecopetrol и Mineros сообщили о высокой прибыли, а большая часть остальных материалов носит рутинный характер.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين مشكلات أمنية خطيرة، منها الهجمات على الشرطة، وانفجار قنبلة يدوية قرب شبكة تلفزيونية، وغارة جوية، وعملية اختطاف، مع نقاش مستمر حول ارتفاع مزعوم في هجمات الجماعات المسلحة. والمؤشرات الاقتصادية متباينة، إذ تراجع مؤشر الأسهم نحو 1% في يوم واحد و4.7% خلال الشهر، بينما أعلنت Ecopetrol وMineros أرباحاً قوية، وأغلب التغطيات الأخرى روتينية.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از مشکلات امنیتی جدی است، از جمله حملات به پلیس، انفجار نارنجک نزدیک یک شبکه تلویزیونی، حمله هوایی و یک آدم‌ربایی، همراه با بحثی جاری درباره افزایش ادعایی حملات گروه‌های مسلح. سیگنال‌های اقتصادی متناقض‌اند: شاخص سهام در آن روز حدود 1% و در طول ماه 4.7% افت کرد، در حالی که Ecopetrol و Mineros سودهای چشمگیری گزارش کردند و بیشتر پوشش‌های دیگر روال معمول دارند.
summary.zh: 该时期既有严重的安全问题，包括袭击警察、电视台外发生手榴弹爆炸、一次空袭和一起绑架案，也有关于武装团体袭击增加的说法之争。经济信号喜忧参半：股指当日下跌约1%，当月下跌4.7%，而Ecopetrol和Mineros公布了强劲利润，其他报道大多属于常规内容。
summary.tr: Bu dönemde polise yönelik saldırılar, bir televizyon kanalının dışında gerçekleşen el bombası patlaması, bir hava saldırısı ve bir kaçırma olayı gibi ciddi güvenlik sorunları bir arada yaşandı; silahlı grupların saldırılarında iddia edilen artışa ilişkin tartışma sürüyor. Ekonomik göstergeler karışık: hisse senedi endeksi o gün yaklaşık %1, ay boyunca ise %4,7 düştü; Ecopetrol ve Mineros güçlü kârlar açıkladı, diğer haberlerin çoğu ise rutin nitelikte.
summary.es: El período combina graves problemas de seguridad, como ataques contra la policía, la explosión de una granada frente a una cadena de televisión, un bombardeo aéreo y un secuestro, con un debate en curso sobre un supuesto aumento de los ataques de grupos armados. Las señales económicas son mixtas: el índice bursátil cayó cerca de un 1% en la jornada y un 4,7% en el mes, mientras que Ecopetrol y Mineros reportaron ganancias sólidas, y la mayoría del resto de la cobertura es rutinaria.
summary.fr: La période combine de graves problèmes de sécurité, notamment des attaques contre la police, l'explosion d'une grenade devant une chaîne de télévision, une frappe aérienne et un enlèvement, ainsi qu'un débat en cours sur une prétendue hausse des attaques de groupes armés. Les signaux économiques sont contrastés : l'indice boursier a reculé d'environ 1 % sur la journée et de 4,7 % sur le mois, tandis qu'Ecopetrol et Mineros ont annoncé de solides bénéfices, et la plupart des autres informations sont de routine.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum ist von ernsten Sicherheitsproblemen geprägt, darunter Angriffe auf die Polizei, eine Granatenexplosion vor einem Fernsehsender, ein Luftangriff und eine Entführung, sowie eine anhaltende Debatte über einen behaupteten Anstieg von Angriffen bewaffneter Gruppen. Die Wirtschaftssignale sind gemischt: Der Aktienindex fiel am Tag um etwa 1 % und im Monatsverlauf um 4,7 %, während Ecopetrol und Mineros starke Gewinne meldeten; die übrige Berichterstattung ist größtenteils routinemäßig.
summary.pt: O período combina sérios problemas de segurança, incluindo ataques contra a polícia, a explosão de uma granada em frente a uma emissora de TV, um ataque aéreo e um sequestro, além de um debate em andamento sobre um suposto aumento de ataques de grupos armados. Os sinais econômicos são mistos: o índice da bolsa caiu cerca de 1% no dia e 4,7% no mês, enquanto Ecopetrol e Mineros registraram lucros expressivos, e a maior parte das demais notícias é rotineira.
summary.ja: この期間は、警察への攻撃、テレビ局前での手榴弾爆発、空爆、誘拐など深刻な治安問題が相次ぐ一方、武装グループによる攻撃が増加したとの主張をめぐる議論が続いている。経済面の指標はまちまちで、株価指数は当日に約1%、1か月で4.7%下落した一方、EcopetrolとMinerosは好調な利益を発表した。その他の報道の大半は定例的な内容である。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 경찰에 대한 공격, 한 TV 방송국 앞에서의 수류탄 폭발, 공습, 납치 등 심각한 치안 문제가 이어지는 가운데, 무장 단체의 공격이 늘었다는 주장을 둘러싼 논쟁이 계속되고 있다. 경제 지표는 엇갈리는데, 주가지수는 당일 약 1%, 한 달간 4.7% 하락했으며, Ecopetrol과 Mineros는 강력한 이익을 보고했다. 그 밖의 보도 대부분은 일상적인 내용이다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में गंभीर सुरक्षा समस्याएँ सामने आईं, जिनमें पुलिस पर हमले, एक टीवी नेटवर्क के बाहर हथगोले का विस्फोट, एक हवाई हमला और एक अपहरण शामिल हैं, साथ ही सशस्त्र समूहों के हमलों में कथित वृद्धि पर बहस जारी है। आर्थिक संकेत मिले-जुले हैं: शेयर सूचकांक दिन में लगभग 1% और महीने में 4.7% गिरा, जबकि Ecopetrol और Mineros ने मजबूत मुनाफ़े की सूचना दी, और अन्य अधिकांश कवरेज नियमित है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει σοβαρά προβλήματα ασφάλειας, μεταξύ άλλων επιθέσεις κατά της αστυνομίας, έκρηξη χειροβομβίδας έξω από τηλεοπτικό δίκτυο, αεροπορική επίθεση και απαγωγή, με μια συνεχιζόμενη συζήτηση για τον υποτιθέμενο αριθμό επιθέσεων ενόπλων ομάδων. Τα οικονομικά σήματα είναι αντιφατικά: ο δείκτης του χρηματιστηρίου υποχώρησε κατά περίπου 1% μέσα στην ημέρα και κατά 4,7% μέσα στον μήνα, ενώ οι Ecopetrol και Mineros ανακοίνωσαν ισχυρά κέρδη, και η υπόλοιπη κάλυψη είναι συνηθισμένη.

summary.en: The UN biodiversity conference COP17 has opened in Armenia, and the country is attracting international attention. However, routine domestic political tensions continue, including the nationalisation of the electricity grid, relations with the EU, opposition-church tensions, and claims of politically motivated dismissals. With no clear crisis or major positive breakthrough, the score remains neutral.

Nationalisation of the electricity grid (ENA) and arbitration dispute
Reports on the possible consequences of withdrawal from the EU
Tension between opposition and government, church and dismissal claims
Uncertainty over the peace agenda with Azerbaijan

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and diplomatic items (new Air Serbia flights, flower exports, the TRIPP copper deal) with serious political strain. Opposition arrests and detentions ahead of Stepanavan elections
Vote-buying and electoral-violation allegations against officials

summary.fr: La journée a combiné des déclarations de fort soutien européen et des avancées parlementaires sur l'axe TRIPP, face à la pression russe, avec notamment des informations faisant état de la perte par l'Arménie de ses droits de vote au sein de l'OTSC. Les coupures de courant programmées de façon routinière et quelques éléments mineurs ont peu modifié le bilan net, et le ton GDELT est légèrement plus favorable que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Tag brachte eindeutige europäische Unterstützungserklärungen und parlamentarische Fortschritte bei der TRIPP-Route, dazu russischen Druck, darunter Berichte, Armenien habe sein Stimmrecht in der OVKS verloren. summary.pt: O dia reuniu declarações firmes de apoio europeu e avanços parlamentares na rota TRIPP, em meio à pressão russa, incluindo relatos de que a Armênia perdeu seus direitos de voto na OTSC. summary.ko: 이날은 유럽의 강력한 지지 표명과 TRIPP 회랑 관련 의회 진전이 있었던 한편, 러시아의 압박과 아르메니아가 집단안보조약기구(CSTO)의 투표권을 상실했다는 보도도 나왔다. 계획된 정기 정전과 몇 가지 사소한 사안은 전체적으로 큰 변화를 주지 않았으며, GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 약간 나은 수준이다.
summary.hi: इस दिन यूरोप के मजबूत समर्थन के बयानों और TRIPP मार्ग पर संसदीय प्रगति के साथ-साथ रूस के दबाव की खबरें भी रहीं, जिनमें यह रिपोर्ट भी शामिल है कि आर्मेनिया ने CSTO में अपना मतदान अधिकार खो दिया है। नियोजित नियमित बिजली कटौती और कुछ छोटे मुद्दों से शुद्ध रूप से बहुत कम बदलाव आया, और GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से थोड़ा बेहतर है।
summary.el: Η ημέρα συνδύασε ισχυρές δηλώσεις ευρωπαϊκής στήριξης και κοινοβουλευτική πρόοδο για τον διάδρομο TRIPP, με τη ρωσική πίεση να είναι παρούσα, περιλαμβανομένων αναφορών ότι η Αρμενία έχασε τα δικαιώματα ψήφου της στον ΟΣΣΑ. Οι προγραμματισμένες τακτικές διακοπές ρεύματος και ορισμένα μικρά θέματα προσθέτουν ελάχιστη καθαρή μεταβολή, ενώ ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς καλύτερος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.it: La giornata ha combinato dichiarazioni di forte sostegno europeo e progressi parlamentari sul percorso TRIPP con la pressione russa, incluse notizie secondo cui l'Armenia avrebbe perso i diritti di voto nell'OTSC. Interruzioni di corrente programmate di routine e alcuni elementi minori aggiungono poco spostamento netto, e il tono GDELT è leggermente migliore della media mondiale.
summary.ru: День сочетал заявления о сильной поддержке со стороны Европы и продвижение в парламенте по маршруту TRIPP на фоне давления со стороны России, включая сообщения о лишении Армении права голоса в ОДКБ. Плановые регулярные отключения электроэнергии и несколько второстепенных событий почти не меняют общую картину, а тон GDELT немного лучше среднемирового.
summary.ar: جمع اليوم بين تصريحات دعم أوروبي قوية وتقدم برلماني بشأن مسار TRIPP في ظل ضغوط روسية، بما في ذلك تقارير عن فقدان أرمينيا حق التصويت في منظمة معاهدة الأمن الجماعي. ولا تضيف انقطاعات الكهرباء المجدولة المعتادة وبعض البنود الثانوية الكثير من التغير الصافي، وتونة GDELT أفضل قليلاً من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: این روز ترکیبی از اظهارات قوی حمایت اروپا و پیشرفت پارلمانی در مسیر TRIPP در برابر فشار روسیه بود، از جمله گزارش‌هایی مبنی بر از دست دادن حق رأی ارمنستان در سازمان پیمان امنیت جمعی. قطعی‌های برق برنامه‌ریزی‌شدهٔ معمول و چند مورد جزئی تغییر خالص چندانی ایجاد نمی‌کنند و لحن GDELT کمی بهتر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 当天既有欧洲的强烈支持表态，也有议会就TRIPP路线取得的进展，同时面临俄罗斯施压，包括有报道称亚美尼亚失去集体安全条约组织的投票权。例行的计划性停电和一些次要事项对净变化影响不大，GDELT语气略优于全球平均水平。

summary.en: War continues in Sudan. Drone attacks in Kordofan, Darfur, Khartoum and Abyei killed more than 100 civilians within 24 hours, including three children. A record parallel-market dollar rate and an increase in the customs dollar rate are deepening the economic collapse; the UN condemned the attacks.

en: Drone attacks in Kordofan, Darfur and Khartoum killed more than 100 civilians
An attack on a market in Abyei killed dozens of people and raised tensions with South Sudan
Drone attacks near Khartoum Airport; three children were killed and services were disrupted
The customs dollar rate rose to 5631 pounds, and the parallel-market exchange rate hit a record
Clashes in the Blue Nile and the continuing army-RSF war

summary.en: Sudan's period is dominated by mass drone strikes killing over 150 people at an Abyei market and more than 100 across Kordofan, Darfur and Khartoum, alongside child deaths, a severe bread shortage and famine warnings. Peace talks returning to Geneva are the only positive thread, which does not offset the ongoing mass violence.

en: Drone strike on Abyei market kills at least 153 people
Over 100 killed in drone attacks across Kordofan, Darfur, Khartoum
UN condemns drone strikes; warns of disrupted services nationwide

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with intensive drone strikes, including a reported market strike in Abyei killing at least 153, and UN peace talks ended without progress. Currency collapse past 10,000 per dollar and hunger reports deepen the humanitarian catastrophe, with only minor positives such as reopened exam windows and a revived oil corporation.

en: Drone strike on Abyei market reportedly kills at least 153
UN peace talks end without progress amid deepening war
Pound falls past 10,000 per dollar; hunger crisis widens

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war is producing a major humanitarian crisis: 19.5 million people face food insecurity, drone strikes continue, and reports allege RSF attacks on hospitals in El-Fasher. Ceasefire talks in Geneva failed, and inflation is rising, with the dollar at SDG 10,300, though the army's recapture of Blue Nile areas is a minor counterpoint.

en: Ceasefire talks in Geneva failed again
19.5 million facing food insecurity amid violence
Reports of RSF deliberately targeting hospitals in El-Fasher

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with drone strikes killing at least 306 people in three weeks, reports of hospital attacks, an alleged massacre in Abyei, and a looming famine risk worsened by drought and aid shortfalls. Protests in army-held areas and market paralysis add to the picture, with only minor positives such as an army base retaken and press union recognition.

en: Drone strikes killed at least 306 people in three weeks
Famine risk warnings amid drought and declining aid
Alleged Abyei massacre and RSF attacks on hospitals

summary.en: Sudan's war is ongoing, with drone strikes causing mass casualties, reported massacres, and a strike on a senior RSF leader's residence. Modest positives, including RSF officer defections, army field gains, and renewed Quad diplomacy in Geneva, do not offset the widespread violence and humanitarian strain.

en: Drone attacks killed 306 people in October, per UN rights chief
Army strike on RSF leader's residence and reported commander deaths
Reported massacres and Amnesty torture allegations in El Fasher

summary.en: Sudan's war continues with famine warnings for 19.5 million people, drone strikes reported to have killed 306 in three weeks, and protests in Atbara. Diplomatic activity, including UN and Arab League efforts and expected dialogue steps, offers only a faint positive signal.

en: Famine risk rising; 19.5 million face acute hunger
Drone strikes reportedly killed 306 people in three weeks
Protests in Atbara on 25 October anniversary

summary.en: Sudan's 24 hours were dominated by continued war: drone strikes killing 21 in Nyala, power stations hit causing mass outages across several states, and famine warnings from major powers, with the anniversary of the El Fasher atrocities recalling mass violence. Limited positives such as a proposed one-month humanitarian truce, aid pledges and a government removal of customs on basic foods do not offset the severity.

en: Drone strikes kill 21 in Nyala and hit power stations causing outages
Famine warnings from US and allies; atrocities in El Fasher persist
UK sanctions on 15 commanders; US proposes one-month humanitarian truce

summary.en: Sudan's war continued over the last 24 hours with a drone strike on a South Darfur market reportedly killing over 100 people, drone attacks cutting power across Khartoum and other states, and Western governments warning of famine risk. No positive developments of note appear; the only offsetting item is a minor measure exempting basic foods from customs.

en: Drone strike on Nyala market reportedly kills 100+ civilians
Drone attacks on power stations cause widespread blackouts in several states
US, EU and 30 countries warn of famine risk

summary.en: Sudan's war continued with a drone strike on a Darfur market reported to have killed over 100 people, later put at 188, plus drone attacks on power stations and fresh displacement in Blue Nile. Famine warnings, rising bread prices and UN calls for an arms embargo point to a severe humanitarian crisis.

en: Nyala market drone strike, reported death toll of 100 to 188
Drone strikes on power stations and fuel depots cutting electricity
Fresh displacement from fighting in Blue Nile and El Obeid

summary.en: The 24-hour news flow is dominated by an ongoing war: drone strikes on civilians and infrastructure, a new 120,000-person displacement, looming famine, and reports of wartime sexual violence. Peace calls and a UAE arms-trafficking verdict are minor offsets, and GDELT tone is much more negative than the world average.

en: Drone strikes killing civilians and knocking out electricity and hospitals
Famine warnings and renewed displacement, including 120,000 people in Blue Nile
Investigation into commanders linked to wartime rape

summary.en: The 24-hour flow is dominated by the ongoing war: drone strikes knocked out power stations in Shendi and elsewhere, El Fasher humanitarian appeals continue, and Port Sudan faces water shortages. Modest positives, including a rail recovery plan, a polio campaign and an RSF commander's defection, do not offset the widespread violence and infrastructure damage.

en: Drone strikes disabling power stations and fuel depots in Shendi and other cities
El Fasher humanitarian crisis and appeals for international aid
Port Sudan water shortages and infrastructure strain

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues to escalate, with drone strikes on power stations and civilian sites, shelling in Kordofan, a UN chief condemnation citing hundreds of deaths, and cross-border accusations against Ethiopia. Only minor positives appear, such as partial recovery of drug supply chains and EU-funded demining, which do not offset the widespread violence.

en: Drone strikes on power stations and civilian sites, hundreds reported killed
Cross-border accusations between Sudan and Ethiopia over drone launches
Displaced people in Blue Nile and Darfur face water and food shortages

summary.en: Sudan's war continued with drone strikes on power stations that left parts of the east under blackout and pushed the grid toward collapse, and the UN reported hundreds killed by drones. Sudan filed complaints against Ethiopia, and new displacement was reported in North Darfur, Blue Nile and Kordofan. A UN envoy's expectation of RSF talks within weeks and Egypt-Sudan water cooperation are modest positives.

en: Drone strikes knocked out power stations, causing blackouts and near grid collapse
UN reports drone attacks killed hundreds across Sudan
Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia over drone attacks

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with drone strikes on power stations causing widespread outages, civilian casualties, and famine warnings, alongside cross-border accusations against Ethiopia. Minor positives such as dissolution of RSF civilian administration are outweighed by mass violence and humanitarian deterioration.

en: Drone attacks hitting power stations and causing nationwide outages
Civilian deaths in Darfur drone strikes and famine warnings
Sudan accuses Ethiopia of backing RSF drone attacks

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war dominated the period, with deadly drone strikes on civilians, a reported massacre in South Kordofan, a joint force commander killed, and a UN famine warning. Minor positives, such as Abyei community rapprochement and a peace envoy awaiting talks, do not offset the mass violence and humanitarian crisis.

en: Deadly RSF drone strikes causing civilian casualties and UN warnings
Reported massacre and fuel station strike with dozens of casualties in Kordofan
UN warns Sudan on brink of famine

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues to drive civilian deaths from drone strikes, power and fuel infrastructure damage, bread shortages and hunger warnings from the UN and others. Diplomatic tensions also escalated, with Ethiopia and Sudan expelling diplomats and closing consulates, and Egypt threatening its defence pact.

en: Drone attacks killing civilians and crippling power infrastructure, per UN
Ethiopia-Sudan mutual diplomatic expulsions and consulate closures
Bread shortages and hunger threats amid war and inflation

summary.en: Sudan's war continues with fighting in Kordofan and Blue Nile, drone strikes in Abyei, and displacement of thousands. Acute hunger is spreading (20 million in severe food insecurity), and Sudan and Ethiopia have expelled diplomats and closed consulates, so the period falls in the war and humanitarian-catastrophe band.

en: Ongoing SAF-RSF fighting in Kordofan and Blue Nile
Bread crisis; 20 million facing severe food insecurity
Drone strikes in Abyei; Sudan-Ethiopia diplomatic expulsions

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with active fighting in Kordofan and Blue Nile, drone strikes opening a new front in Abyei, and UN warnings that over 15 million people need shelter amid severe aid shortages and fuel shortages threatening harvests. Sanctions and leaked reports on foreign mercenary involvement add to the sense of a deepening humanitarian and conflict crisis.

en: Army and RSF clashes intensify in Kordofan and Blue Nile
UN: 15.4 million people need urgent shelter, aid minimal
Drone strikes open new front in Abyei crisis

summary.en: Sudan's war continues with clashes in Blue Nile and West Kordofan, drone attacks, and aid agencies reporting over 15 million people displaced. Minor positives, such as a Pakistan visa-free agreement and army gains in West Kordofan, do not offset the ongoing armed conflict and humanitarian crisis.

en: Ongoing RSF-army fighting in Blue Nile and Kordofan
Over 15 million displaced; aid teams describe worsening suffering
Army advances in West Kordofan and drone interceptions

summary.en: The war continues with army advances and drone clashes in Kordofan, displacement in North Darfur, and worsening food and fuel shortages that are damaging crops and bakeries. Positive signals, such as the arrest of an ICC-wanted figure and RSF defectors arriving in Khartoum, do not offset the ongoing humanitarian crisis.

en: Ongoing war with army advances and drone clashes in Kordofan
Fuel shortages damaging crops and bread shortages driving hunger risk
Fresh mass displacement reported in North Darfur

summary.en: Sudan's war continues, with a drone strike in Blue Nile reportedly killing nine civilians, fires at oil fields, teacher strikes, and a 15.4 million-person aid need. Partial positives include Khartoum's gradual return to normal life, an RSF commander's defection, and the arrest of Ahmed Haroun, which is contested.

en: Drone strike kills nine civilians in Blue Nile
15.4 million Sudanese need urgent humanitarian aid
Oil field fires and teacher strikes deepen economic strain

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war dominates the period, with drone strikes killing civilians, famine warnings in Darfur, and widespread displacement and power outages. Only minor positives appear, such as a heritage museum opening and banking reform commentary, so the score sits in the war-and-humanitarian-catastrophe band.

en: Drone strikes killing displaced civilians in Blue Nile and elsewhere
Darfur famine warnings and crop failure reports
UNICEF and UN surveys: drones and drought threaten children; two-thirds of households lost livelihoods

summary.en: The war continues with drone strikes killing civilians, drone shootdowns in Kordofan and Darfur, and UN reports of famine and widespread livelihood loss. Modest positives (Swedish aid pledge, lifted tea ban, airport readiness, an archaeological find) do not offset the ongoing violence and humanitarian strain.

en: Drone strike killed nine civilians in Blue Nile
UN: one in three households lost livelihoods
OCHA: 71 aid workers killed in 2025

summary.en: The ongoing war dominates the day, with drone strikes on power infrastructure and civilians, a 9-death attack in Blue Nile, famine warnings and new displacement into Darfur. Partial positives, such as G7 backing for a Quad-led ceasefire push and reported RSF defections, do not offset the continuing mass violence and humanitarian crisis.
summary.tr: Devam eden savaş günün gündemine hakim; elektrik altyapısına ve sivillere yönelik insansız hava aracı saldırıları, Mavi Nil'de 9 ölümle sonuçlanan bir saldırı, kıtlık uyarıları ve Darfur'a yeni yerinden edilmeler yaşanıyor. G7'nin Quad öncülüğündeki ateşkes girişimine verdiği destek ve bildirilen RSF firarileri gibi kısmi olumlu gelişmeler, süren kitlesel şiddeti ve insani krizi dengelemiyor.
summary.es: La guerra en curso domina la jornada, con ataques de drones contra la infraestructura eléctrica y contra civiles, un ataque en el Nilo Azul con 9 muertos, advertencias de hambruna y nuevos desplazamientos hacia Darfur. Los avances parciales, como el respaldo del G7 a la iniciativa de alto el fuego liderada por el Cuadrilátero y las deserciones informadas de las RSF, no compensan la violencia masiva y la crisis humanitaria que continúan.
summary.fr: La guerre en cours domine l'actualité de la journée, avec des frappes de drones sur les infrastructures électriques et sur des civils, une attaque dans le Nil Bleu ayant fait 9 morts, des alertes à la famine et de nouveaux déplacements vers le Darfour. Des éléments positifs partiels, comme le soutien du G7 à l'initiative de cessez-le-feu menée par le Quad et les défections signalées au sein des FSR, ne compensent pas la poursuite des violences de masse et de la crise humanitaire.
summary.de: Der andauernde Krieg beherrscht das Tagesgeschehen: Drohnenangriffe auf Stromversorgung und Zivilisten, ein Angriff im Blauen Nil mit neun Todesopfern, Hungerwarnungen und neue Vertreibungen nach Darfur. Teilweise positive Entwicklungen, etwa die Unterstützung der G7 für die vom Quad angeführten Waffenstillstandsbemühungen und gemeldete Abspaltungen bei den RSF, wiegen die anhaltende massive Gewalt und die humanitäre Krise nicht auf.
summary.pt: A guerra em curso domina o dia, com ataques de drones contra infraestruturas elétricas e civis, um ataque no Nilo Azul com nove mortos, alertas de fome e novos deslocamentos para Darfur. Avanços parciais, como o apoio do G7 à iniciativa de cessar-fogo liderada pelo Quad e as deserções relatadas nas RSF, não compensam a violência em massa e a crise humanitária que continuam.
summary.it: La guerra in corso domina la giornata, con attacchi di droni contro infrastrutture elettriche e civili, un attacco nel Nilo Azzurro con 9 morti, allarmi di carestia e nuovi sfollamenti verso il Darfur. Segnali parzialmente positivi, come il sostegno del G7 a una spinta per il cessate il fuoco guidata dal Quad e le defezioni riportate nelle RSF, non attenuano la violenza di massa in corso e la crisi umanitaria.
summary.ru: Продолжающаяся война доминирует в повестке дня: удары беспилотников по энергетической инфраструктуре и гражданскому населению, нападение в Голубом Ниле с девятью погибшими, предупреждения о голоде и новое перемещение людей в Дарфур. Частичные позитивные сигналы, такие как поддержка G7 усилий по прекращению огня под руководством Квадриги и сообщения о дезертирстве из RSF, не компенсируют продолжающееся массовое насилие и гуманитарный кризис.
summary.ar: تهيمن الحرب المستمرة على المشهد اليوم، مع ضربات بالطائرات المسيّرة تستهدف البنية التحتية للكهرباء والمدنيين، وهجوم في النيل الأزرق أودى بحياة تسعة أشخاص، وتحذيرات من المجاعة ونزوح جديد نحو دارفور. ولا تُعوّض الإيجابيات الجزئية، مثل دعم مجموعة السبع لمساعي وقف إطلاق النار بقيادة الرباعية وتقارير عن انشقاقات في قوات الدعم السريع، استمرار العنف الجماعي والأزمة الإنسانية.
summary.fa: جنگ جاری بر امروز سایه افکنده است؛ حملات پهپادی به زیرساخت‌های برق و غیرنظامیان، حمله‌ای در نیل آبی با نُه کشته، هشدارهای قحطی و آوارگی تازه به سمت دارفور. نشانه‌های مثبت جزئی، از جمله حمایت گروه ۷ از تلاش برای آتش‌بس به رهبری چهارگانه و گزارش‌های جدایی نیروهای پشتیبانی سریع، خشونت گسترده و بحران بشردوستانه ادامه‌دار را جبران نمی‌کنند.
summary.zh: 持续的战争主导了当天的新闻：无人机袭击电力基础设施和平民，青尼罗河州发生造成9人死亡的袭击，饥荒预警以及新的人口向达尔富尔流离失所。G7支持由“四方”牵头的停火努力，以及有报道称快速支援部队出现叛逃等部分积极迹象，并不能抵消持续的大规模暴力和人道主义危机。
summary.ja: 進行中の戦争が本日の主要な出来事であり、電力インフラと民間人へのドローン攻撃、ブルーナイル州での9人死亡の攻撃、飢饉への警告、ダルフール地域への新たな避難民流入が報じられている。G7によるクアッド主導の停戦努力への支持や、RSF(即応支援部隊)からの離反の報道といった部分的な前向きの動きはあるものの、続く大規模な暴力と人道危機を相殺するには至っていない。
summary.ko: 진행 중인 전쟁이 오늘의 주요 사안으로, 전력 인프라와 민간인을 겨냥한 드론 공격, 블루나일주에서 9명이 숨진 공격, 기근 경고, 다르푸르로의 새로운 피란민 유입이 이어지고 있다. 쿼드 주도의 휴전 추진에 대한 G7의 지지와 RSF(신속지원군) 이탈 보도 등 일부 긍정적 소식도 있으나, 계속되는 대규모 폭력과 인도주의 위기를 상쇄하지는 못한다.
summary.hi: जारी युद्ध आज की प्रमुख खबर है, जिसमें बिजली के बुनियादी ढांचे और नागरिकों पर ड्रोन हमले, ब्लू नाइल में 9 लोगों की मौत वाला हमला, अकाल की चेतावनियां और दारफुर में नए विस्थापन की खबरें शामिल हैं। क्वाड के नेतृत्व वाले युद्धविराम प्रयास के लिए G7 का समर्थन और आरएसएफ से कथित बगावत जैसे आंशिक सकारात्मक संकेत, जारी सामूहिक हिंसा और मानवीय संकट की भरपाई नहीं करते।
summary.el: Ο συνεχιζόμενος πόλεμος κυριαρχεί στην ημέρα, με επιθέσεις drones σε υποδομές ηλεκτρισμού και αμάχους, μια επίθεση στο Μπλε Νείλο με 9 νεκρούς, προειδοποιήσεις για λιμό και νέα εκτοπισμό προς το Νταρφούρ. Τα μερικά θετικά στοιχεία, όπως η στήριξη της G7 στην προσπάθεια εκεχειρίας υπό την ηγεσία της Quad και οι αναφερόμενες αποχωρήσεις από τις RSF, δεν αντισταθμίζουν τη συνεχιζόμενη μαζική βία και την ανθρωπιστική κρίση.

summary.it: Il periodo è stato in gran parte di routine, con un mercato azionario stabile (+1,25% nel corso della settimana) e una forte stagione delle mele. Il principale aspetto negativo è stato un mercato immobiliare debole, con le vendite di ottobre in calo del 23,5% su base annua e prezzi in diminuzione per il quinto mese consecutivo, insieme a un incidente mortale ad Auckland.
summary.ru: Период в целом прошёл спокойно: фондовый рынок оставался стабильным (+1,25% за неделю), а сезон яблок был удачным. Главным негативным фактором стал слабый рынок жилья: продажи в октябре снизились на 23,5% в годовом выражении, а цены падали уже пятый месяц подряд, также произошла смертельная авария в Окленде.
summary.ar: كان الأسبوع روتينيًا إلى حد كبير، مع استقرار سوق الأسهم (بارتفاع 1.25% خلال الأسبوع) وموسم تفاح قوي. وكان أبرز الجوانب السلبية ضعف سوق الإسكان، إذ انخفضت مبيعات شهر أكتوبر بنسبة 23.5% على أساس سنوي، وتراجعت الأسعار للشهر الخامس على التوالي، إلى جانب حادث سير مميت في أوكلاند.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی بود، با بازار سهام باثبات (افزایش ۱٫۲۵ درصدی در طول هفته) و فصل قوی سیب. عامل منفی اصلی، بازار مسکن ضعیف بود؛ فروش‌های مهر ماه نسبت به سال گذشته ۲۳٫۵ درصد کاهش یافت و قیمت‌ها برای پنجمین ماه پیاپی افت کردند. همچنین یک تصادف مرگبار در اوکلند رخ داد.

summary.es: El periodo transcurrió en gran medida con normalidad, con un mercado bursátil estable (+1,25% en la semana) y una buena temporada de manzanas. El principal aspecto negativo fue un mercado inmobiliario débil: las ventas de vivienda de octubre cayeron un 23,5% interanual y los precios bajaron por quinto mes consecutivo, además de un accidente mortal en Auckland.
